title: Which Truck Brand Is Actually the Most Reliable? 4 Studies Disagree (2027)
description:
Which truck brand is really the most reliable? We put Consumer Reports, J.D. Power's dependability and initial quality studies, and iSeeCars longevity data side by side, and explain why they disagree. Every figure comes from a published source, listed below.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
2:06 Round 1: Consumer Reports
7:05 Round 2: J.D. Power dependability
11:55 Round 3: J.D. Power initial quality
14:12 Round 4: Who reaches 250,000 miles
18:34 Brand scorecard
20:37 The verdict and what to check in 2027

Sources:
- Consumer Reports, 2026 Automotive Brand Report Card (Dec 4, 2025): https://www.consumerreports.org/media-room/press-releases/2025/12/consumer-reports-releases-its-2026-automotive-brand-report-card-the-comprehensive-analysis-of-vehicle-quality-to-help-guide-car-shoppers-amid-steep-prices
- Pickup Truck + SUV Talk, Consumer Reports full-size truck reliability for 2026: https://pickuptrucktalk.com/2025/12/consumer-reports-least-reliable-full-size-trucks-for-2026/
- Pickup Truck + SUV Talk, Consumer Reports heavy-duty reliability for 2026: https://pickuptrucktalk.com/2026/07/consumer-reports-least-reliable-heavy-duty-trucks-for-2026/
- Pickup Truck + SUV Talk, J.D. Power 2026 VDS pickups: https://pickuptrucktalk.com/2026/02/most-reliable-2026-truck-is-ram-1500-chevy-silverado-next-toyota-misses-out-jd-power-study/
- Stellantis, Ram 1500 No. 1 in J.D. Power 2026 VDS: https://media.stellantisnorthamerica.com/newsrelease.do?id=27455

- Automotive Fleet, iSeeCars trucks that last over 250,000 miles (2023): https://www.automotive-fleet.com/news/study-reveals-trucks-that-can-last-over-250000-miles
